observation_cutoff: Candidate source, task specification, and only the tests and metrics enabled for the current iteration.
transition: Fresh compile and simulation with Icarus Verilog followed, when enabled, by generic Yosys synthesis.
termination: Compile failure, functional failure, exploit failure, held-out transfer failure, or successful completion.
grader: Vector of compile, visible examples, exhaustive hidden behavior, generic synthesis cell count, exploit checks, and held-out-width transfer.
next_falsifiable_gate: A second operator reproduces all five results from a clean checkout.
stop_rule: Stop calling this an environment if reset/replay is not deterministic, or stop calling the proxy useful if it fails to rank later-stage outcomes.
